svg.title: nahuya в Claude Code
svg.desc: Four replays of Claude Code sessions with Opus 5.5. 1, push gate: Claude builds discount codes and pushes; the gate blocks 113 unreviewed lines, nahuya:polish runs a fresh reviewer, it finds nothing to cut, and the push goes through. 2, whole-repo cleanup of a 40k-line Minecraft mod (rebuilt from the session transcript): Claude plans 12 components, asks about tests and the reviewer budget, reviews 7 components, and makes 13 commits, net -190 lines with all 218 game tests green. 3, test cleanup: 98 tests written by Claude without nahuya are pruned to 75, -113 lines, checks green. 4, report-only review of an over-engineered notification module: 3 findings, about -40 lines, nothing changed.
